commits.subject: Update GKE skills to clarify Autopilot defaults, VPC-Native benefits, and Backup for GKE best practices: - gke-cluster-creation: Add warning and operational details when deviating to GKE Standard mode. - gke-networking: Document benefits of VPC-Native mode (scalability, direct VPC integration, avoiding IP exhaustion). - gke-golden-path: Update defaults table to include loggingConfig. - gke-backup-dr: Add best practices for stateful backups (quiescing, CSI snapshots, service terminology).
commits.summary: Added a VPC-native mode benefits section covering scalability, direct VPC integration, and reduced IP-exhaustion risk.
